functions.purpose: TDR human-readable text-dump of the full Guild data TLV struct (guild economy state). Walks every field/nested-list emitting '[label] value' lines. No arithmetic; pure struct-to-text. Reveals the guild economy layout: fund, reputation, resources (A/B/C/D), and their daily/weekly/max counters, guild-commerce commodity unlocks, celebration scores and hunt-soul.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only (debug/log text formatter); but documents the server-authoritative guild economy struct layout
formulas: level @ param_1[0x89]; exp @ [0x8a]; repute @ [0x8b]; fund @ [0x8c] (i32); arena @ [0x8d]; resA @ [0x8e]; resB @ [0x8f]; joinLevel @ [0x90]; leader int64 @ [0x91],[0x92]

fundMax int64 @ byte-off 0x362e9 (param_1[0xd8b9],[0xd8ba]); hallLevel(u8) @ 0x362ec; recruitingLevel(u8) @ 0x362ed; resourcingLevel(u8) @ 0x362ee; tradingLevel(u8) @ 0x362ef; trainingLevel(u8) @ 0x362f0; guilderCountMax(u32) @ 0x362f1
fundDaily int64 @ 0x362f5; fundWeekly int64 @ 0x362fd; commodityUnlock1 int64 @ 0x36305; commodityUnlock2 @ 0x3630d; commodityUnlock3 @ 0x36315; fundDailyTime @ 0x3631d; fundWeeklyTime @ 0x36321
addFundWithDay @ 0x3635d; consumeFundWithDay @ 0x36361; plot @ 0x36365; questPrize @ 0x6df65; contribution @ 0x6df69; huntSoul int64 @ 0x6df71; celebrationScore @ 0x6df91
signUpCount(i32) @ 0x38dda validated: <0 -> -6, >0x40(64) -> -7; depotOpenFlag(u8) @ param_1[0x1b7b4]
costs: Guild fund (i64 fund/fundMax/fundDaily/fundWeekly) and 4 guild resources resA-D with daily/weekly accrual and max caps — guild economy currency pools
guilderCountMax = guild member capacity
functions.notes: Calls TlvTitleList/GuildMemberList/GuildApplyList/SkillList/StoreData/GuildCommerceData/GuildFuncRecords/GuildBuyRecords printers. seed int64 @ [0..1], icon @ [0xb]. Signup array elements printed via FUN_1012c700; stores via TlvStoreData_DebugPrint; randCommodities via FUN_1012a660; quest via FUN_1012aea0.

functions.purpose: TDR text-dump of the master character attribute TLV (TlvCharRoleAttributes @0x101B6660 per TLV_DOCS). Emits ~168 fields. This is the authoritative per-character economy/progression state: all currencies, weapon EXP pools, VIP timers, clan/PVP currencies, hunt-soul, HR level. No arithmetic — just field-by-field print, but it is the canonical currency-offset map.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only formatter; struct is fully server-authoritative — these are the exact offsets the server must own for currency/EXP mutations
formulas: roleGID int64 @ [0],[1]; oCharLevel @ [2]; oCharExp @ [3]; oStarLevel @ [4]; oCharHP @ [5]; oCharMaxHP @ [6]; oCharStr [7]; oCharBst [8]; oCharLck [9]; oCharVgr [10]; oCharDefence [0xb]

CURRENCIES: oCharMoney @ [0xc]; oCharBoundMoney @ [0xd]; oCharCredit @ [0xe]; oCharBoundCredit @ [0xf]; oCharCatCredit @ [0x30]; oCharReviveCredit @ [0x31]; oClanMoney @ +0x152; oClanMoneyPVP @ +0x15e; oPVPMoney @ +0x196; oCharCatMoney @ +0x19a; oCharCatMoneyWeek @ +0x19e (cap oCharCatMoneyWeekMax @ +0x1a2); oTotalCredit float @ +0x1ba

oCharFatigue @ [0x10]; oCharMaxFatigue @ [0x11]; weapon EXP: oClaymoreExp [0x12], oHammerExp [0x13], oKatanaExp [0x14], oDuelSwordExp [0x15], oSwordExp [0x16], oSpearExp [0x17], oGunExp [0x18], oBowExp [0x19], oCrossbowExp [0x1a], oFluteExp [0x1b]
oCharContribution @ [0x21]; oCharRemainsExp @ [0x22]; oFarmExp @ +0x8e; oExtDailyExp @ [0x33]; oCharRemainsDoubleExp @ [0x45]; oExtDailyDoubleExp @ [0x46]
VIP: oVIPLevel [0x47]; oVIPExp [0x48]; oVIPBaseEndTime [0x49]; oVIPGrowthEndTime [0x4a]; oVIPProfitEndTime [0x4b]; oBanChatEndTime [0x4c]

oHuntSoul @ +0x1a6; oLevelHuntSoul @ [0x87]; oTaskHuntSoul @ [0x88]; oCampHuntSoul @ [0x89]; oLastHuntSoul @ +0x1c6; oCharHRLevel @ +0x156; oCharHRPoint @ +0x15a; oTotalHRPoint @ +0x1ca; oShouHunPoint @ +0x1ee; oLieHunPoint @ +0x1f2; oMVPPoint @ +0x1f6; oIllustratePoint @ [0x8b]
costs: Primary tradable currency oCharMoney (i32) + bound variant oCharBoundMoney; premium currency oCharCredit + bound oCharBoundCredit + float oTotalCredit
Secondary currencies: cat money/credit (weekly-capped), clan money, PVP money, hunt-soul pools, HR points, MVP/hunt points
Per-weapon EXP pools (10 weapon types) — progression
oCharCatMoneyWeek capped by oCharCatMoneyWeekMax (weekly earning cap)
functions.notes: Confirmed against TLV_DOCS/TlvCharRoleAttributes.md (roleGID@0, oCharLevel@8, oCharExp@12, oStarLevel@16). Many facial/appearance (oFacialInfo1..47), farm, clan-score, monopoly, x-hunter, soul-stone fields also present but non-economy. oIsNewbie @ +0x21a.

functions.purpose: TDR text-dump of the master online-player data blob sent at login/entity-init. Emits session/world/server identity then every inventory and system sub-blob: bag/equip/store items, shortcuts, buffs, skills, pets, attrs, tasks, guild, action-point, guide steps, cooldowns, schedule prizes, mail, npc attitude, item box, item rebuild, soul stone, battle-item use, cuisine level, celebration reward. Documents inventory sizing/caps.
functions.serverRelevance: client-only formatter; struct is the server-authoritative full player snapshot and defines inventory capacity caps the server must enforce
formulas: identity: dwAccountID [0]; iNetID [1]; ullDBId i64 [2],[3]; dwSessionID [4]; dwWorldID [5]; dwServerID [6]; dwWorldSvrID [7]; dwServerTime [8]; dwIsReConnect [9]; szName @ [10]; bGender(u8) @ [0x12]; bIsGM(u8) @ +0x49; iFaction @ +0x6f; iWeapon @ +0x77

INVENTORY CAPS: iBagSize(i32) @ +0x89 cap 82000; szBagItem[] @ +0x8d; wEquipSize(u16) @ +0x140dd cap 0x1000(4096), szEquipItem @ +0x140df; iStoreDataSize(i32) @ +0x150df cap 200000, szStoreItem @ +0x150e3; wStoreSize @ +0x83; wNormalSize @ +0x85; wMaterialStoreSize @ +0x87
wShortcutCount(u16) @ +0x45e23 cap 0x3c(60); wBuffSize @ +0x46005 cap 0x2800(10240); wSkillSize @ +0x48807 cap 0x2800; wPetSize @ +0x4b009 cap 0x2800; wAttrSize @ +0x5685d cap 0x5000(20480)
social caps: iFriendCount @ +0x4d80b cap 500; iPasserbyCount @ +0x55ed3 cap 0x14(20); iBlacklistCount @ +0x562fb cap 0x14; iFriendGroupCount @ +0x5670f cap 10

iTaskLen @ +0x5b85f cap 0x2800; iGuildLen @ +0x5e063 cap 0x400(1024); wGuideStepCount @ +0x5e487 cap 0x100; wCDSize @ +0x5e689 cap 0x400; iSchedulePrizeLen @ +0x5ea8b cap 0x400; iMailInfoLen @ +0x5ee8f cap 0x400; iNpcAtdInfoLen @ +0x5f293 cap 0x400
array count validation pattern throughout: cnt<0 -> -6, cnt>cap -> -7
costs: Defines maximum inventory/store sizes (bag 82000, store 200000, equip 4096) that bound how many items a player may hold — server must cap adds against these
Contains item box / item rebuild / soul stone / battle-item-use sub-blobs (crafting & consumable inventories) and iCelebrationReward / iCanGetRewarded reward flags
functions.notes: Calls TdrDebugFormat_ByteThenFloatSub (stPose), FUN_102b78c0 (shortcut), FUN_102b7db0 (friend), FUN_102b8330 (passerby), FUN_102b8800 (blacklist), FUN_102b8c80 (friend group), TdrDebugFormat_ActionPointData (stActionPoint), FUN_102bc530 (guide step), TdrText_ItemBoxList_astItemBoxList (item box). Tail fields: bCatCuisineLevel, szItemRebuild/iItemRebuildLen, szSoulStone/iSoulStoneLen, szBattleItemUse/dwBattleItemUseLen, itemUseOnceList/wItemUseOnceCount, iCanGetRewarded.
